article.story: RALEIGH, N.C. -- — Ven-Allen Lubin scored a season-high 21 points and grabbed 10 rebounds, and NC State built a double-digit lead early and cruised to a 94-60 victory over Presbyterian on Tuesday night. Lubin, one of three returnees and who didn't miss a game last season, shot 10-of-17 from the floor. He scored 20 points with 10 rebounds in the season-opener against Campbell. Paul McNeil Jr. added 12 points and 12 rebounds for NC State (3-0), which shot 38 of 73. McNeil and Hammond each made three of the Wolfpack's 10 3-pointers. Christian Hammond added 13 points for NC State. Darius Adams scored 12. Triston Wilson scored 14 points for Presbyterian (0-3). NC State pulled away early with an 18-5 run, capped by an Adams 3-pointer, for a double-digit lead midway through the first half and led 46-19 at the break. Lubin scored 14 first-half points. The Blue Hose shot just 6 of 24 and missed all six of their 3-point attempts in the half. The Wolfpack have won all four games in the series. Up next Presbyterian: hosts Mercer on Nov. 18. NC State: at home against Troy on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
